dedupe_keys.name: plasticircle light packaging waste pilots iot collection platform data valencia alba iulia and sorting lca lcc and social lca datasets

description: These data sets come from PlastiCircle, a European research project that piloted a new way of collecting plastic packaging waste with smart containers, tracked trucks and rewards for residents, and then evaluated the results. The producers are the project consortium funded by the EU Horizon 2020 programme, including the packaging institute ITENE, the research organisation SINTEF, the Valencia waste operator SAV and the municipality of Alba Iulia. Coverage is the pilot cities, notably Valencia in Spain and Alba Iulia in Romania. The IoT platform files give labels issued by smart containers, truck eco-driving data such as location, speed, engine speed and load, and citizen rankings and surveys; further deposits give sorting yield and purity, and the economic, environmental and social life cycle assessments of the collection systems and of industries using the recycled plastic. All are available as free spreadsheet downloads from Zenodo under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 licence. Caveats: short pilots, spreadsheets designed for project reporting with limited documentation, and no single guide linking the separate deposits. Simulation uses: modelling smart collection systems with fill-level sensing and route planning, and comparing costs and impacts of separate packaging collection. Related records: the Lahore IoT waste collection pilot (case_study-lahore-iot-waste-collection-pilot) tested similar technology, and SwolfPy (model-swolfpy) models waste system costs.
